exposure: class III obesity (body mass index ≥40 kg/m(2))
cohort: 285 women with class III obesity (BMI ≥40 kg/m(2)) undergoing term induction of labor
finding: Early amniotomy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in women with class III obesity undergoing labor induction, particularly among nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Early amniotomy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in women with class III obesity, particularly nulliparous women.
